description: A complete Python learning roadmap from absolute beginner to pro level, designed for classroom learners, self-paced students, and real-world developers. Includes hands-on examples, exercises, projects, assessments, data science (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn), and creative graphics progression.

modules.title: Statistical Data Visualization with Seaborn
topics: Introduction to Seaborn: High-Level Statistical Graphics built on top of Matplotlib
Seaborn Aesthetic Themes and Palettes: sns.set_theme(), set_style(), set_palette(), color_palette()
Visualizing Univariate & Bivariate Distributions: histplot(), kdeplot(), ecdfplot(), rugplot()
Categorical Visualizations: barplot() (with confidence intervals), countplot(), boxplot(), violinplot()
Categorical Scatter Plots: stripplot() and jitter, swarmplot() for discrete point distributions
Relational Plots: scatterplot() and lineplot() with hue, size, and style dimensional encodings
Matrix & Correlation Plots: Computing correlation matrices and rendering annotated Heatmaps (sns.heatmap())
Customizing Heatmaps: annot=True, fmt, cmap (coolwarm, viridis, magma), cbar, mask for triangle matrices
Multi-Plot Grid Visualizations: PairGrid, pairplot() for pairwise bivariate distributions across all numerical features
Faceted Grids: FacetGrid, catplot(), displot(), and relplot() for split-category dashboards
Regression & Trend Analysis: regplot() and lmplot() with linear fit lines and confidence bands
Fine-Tuning Seaborn with Underlying Matplotlib Axes objects
learningOutcomes: Produce attractive, statistically rigorous visualizations with minimal code using Seaborn
